comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
If such changes were made, it'd have been by KOEI's approval, or direct order. But we only just unlocked the ship, and sometimes Japanese sites give unintentionally misleading data (I expected a recipe to yield EQ with one set of stats, but got another set of stats entirely) in their comments. That's even assuming the translation engines get it right, too. Let's do a bit more research and see what we can come up with.

Though I admit to being in the same boat as Curious; if FC has those aforementioned skill options, I'll be satisfied.
